non-blocking: "24 passed ... the same count in both runs" asserts a head arm at 4d4a74a62 that no surviving log records, because after-armed.log was overwritten at 11:27:30 by the f93b308e8 arm and the only 4d4a74a62 log on disk is gate-pane-suites.log (58 passed over five files), so half of the claim cannot be verified from the delivered evidence.
